_note: RULES569 idea 2 ALONE on today's page (owner: 'a switch that sets the power that goes to your punches would be a good idea'): THE POWER SWITCH. The LAST punch of a beat can be thrown at FULL POWER (you sit down on the punch that ends the combination): +2 stamina, +1 health, one step slower (he sees it coming; a punch that now does 3 or more stops his slower punch, scores 2 and wears the guard, as any big punch). If it is blocked or falls short the thrower is OPEN in his next moment: his guard covers nothing (the last moment of a beat carries to the first of the next). Our numbers, not Mixed Martial Cards' (double damage for +50% stamina): screened at n=12 - +1 / +2 health for +1 stamina ended 67% of bouts early (3.4 knockdowns); +1 health for +1 stamina was thrown on a third of punches; +1 health for +2 stamina on 8% (38% of them not landing). docs/RULES569_RESULT.md.
